title: CQRS: separate query and command models
author: Martin Fowler
reading_path: Database → query model → UI across the top; UI → command model → database across the bottom.
merit: A compact U-shaped story separates read and write responsibility. Small internal model graphs and handwritten leader notes explain the abstraction at two levels.
